text.description_html:
Laurey 38566, Ribbon Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Ribbon Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull is unique in that it can be mounted with either 3 inch mounting centers or 4 inch mounting centers. The Ribbon Oil Rubbed Bronze Pull measures 5 inches overall. This lightweight cabinet pull is an affordable way to update your kitchen's hardware. Each cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting screws. The Ribbon Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull has a transitional style that is sure to catch eyes and turn heads.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Ribbon Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38566 Ribbon Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): Adjustable 3" or 4"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
